findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "compare_payoff_strategies" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_defaults" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Calculation, not advice. Verify with a professional before acting. Returns named default values used by Senaro Finance tools with source citations. Use before c…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
